$comment: License policy for production dependencies (pnpm licenses list --prod). Checked by scripts/myrmidon/check-licenses.mjs. An exception matches a package name together with the exact license string pnpm reports; every exception needs a reason.

exceptions.name: @csstools/color-helpers
exceptions.reason: MIT No Attribution: MIT without the attribution clause, strictly more permissive than MIT.

exceptions.name: @csstools/css-syntax-patches-for-csstree
exceptions.reason: MIT No Attribution: MIT without the attribution clause, strictly more permissive than MIT.

exceptions.name: url-template
exceptions.reason: Non-SPDX label; the bundled LICENSE file is the two-clause BSD license (BSD-2-Clause).

exceptions.name: khroma
exceptions.reason: package.json has no license field; the bundled license file is MIT (Fabio Spampinato, Andrew Maney). Transitive dependency of mermaid in the UI.

exceptions.name: lightningcss
exceptions.reason: Weak file-level copyleft; used unmodified as the CSS transformer of the UI build. MPL obligations apply only to modified MPL files, and we modify none.

exceptions.name: lightningcss-linux-x64-gnu
exceptions.reason: Platform binary of lightningcss (MPL-2.0), used unmodified; see lightningcss.

exceptions.name: lightningcss-linux-x64-musl
exceptions.reason: Platform binary of lightningcss (MPL-2.0), used unmodified; see lightningcss.

exceptions.name: @img/sharp-libvips-linux-x64
exceptions.reason: Prebuilt libvips shared library loaded dynamically by sharp (Apache-2.0), unmodified. LGPL permits dynamic linking; the source is published upstream. Vendor dependency.

exceptions.name: @img/sharp-libvips-linuxmusl-x64
exceptions.reason: Prebuilt libvips shared library loaded dynamically by sharp (Apache-2.0), unmodified; see @img/sharp-libvips-linux-x64.

exceptions.reason: Platform binary of @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk; same terms and review note.
